newsitem.title: THAILAND: Eleven killed, 30 hurt in Thailand bus accident.
newsitem.headline: Eleven killed, 30 hurt in Thailand bus accident.

text.p: Eleven people were killed and 30 were injured when a bus crashed into the railing of a bridge in Yala, 1,400 km (875 miles) south of Bangkok, tossing passengers into the river below, Thai police said on Sunday.

The accident occurred late on Saturday when the driver of the chartered bus heading to a nearby Budhhist temple for Lunar New Year prayers lost control of the vehicle and hit the railing, leaving the bus hanging off the side of the bridge, police in Yala told Reuters.
The eleven drowned and another 30 passengers were taken to hospital.
Police said they believed the bus's brakes had failed but they were investigating further and questioning the bus driver.
